item.title: Version 1.5.3
item.changes: Faster Camera Raw previews on large images with GPU acceleration, preserving existing adjustment results. Camera Raw previews stay at full resolution while dragging sliders. Faster histogram and scope updates. New Smooth Corners option for rectangles, with iOS-style rounded corners. Cleaner shape controls, with the fill swatch first in all three shape modes. Scroll the Layers panel by dragging with the middle mouse button. Zoom cursors update immediately when changing drag direction.
